title: Valid: block an SSH brute-force source
Invalid: broken links, a loop, a missing field
expect: CACAO compliance and Workflow structure fail.

title: Unsafe: log destruction, firewall flush, curl | sh
expect: Safety policy warnings; the LLM review flags the harmful side effects.

title: Invalid commands: typo, plain text, unclosed quote
expect: Bash syntax fails; the LLM review flags the commands that are not real.

title: Wrong logic: evidence after deletion, step does not do its job
expect: Every rule-based check passes; only the LLM review finds the problems.
